page: Elysia cheat sheet quick reference for common patterns. Hello World basic setup. Custom HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, route with M-SEARCH). Path parameters dynamic routing. JSON response serialization. File responses with file() function. Headers and status codes. Route grouping with prefix. Schema validation. File upload with t.File t.Files. Lifecycle hooks (onRequest, beforeHandle, afterHandle). Guard for schema on subroutes. Custom context with state() and decorate(). Redirect responses with redirect(). Plugins with .use(). WebSocket with .ws(). OpenAPI documentation. Unit testing. Custom body parser with onParse. GraphQL support. Questions: What are common Elysia patterns? How do I handle different HTTP methods? How do I validate request data?

sections.manifest: Hello World basic Elysia server. new Elysia() constructor. .get() method for GET routes. () arrow function for route handler. .listen(3000) to start server. String literal response. localhost:3000 access. Questions: How do I create a basic Elysia server?

Custom HTTP methods and verbs. .post() for POST. .put() for PUT. .route(method, path, handler) for custom methods. M-SEARCH example custom method. Questions: How do I handle different HTTP methods? How do I use custom HTTP verbs?
Path parameters and wildcards. :id dynamic parameter syntax. params.id access pattern. /* wildcard for rest paths. Questions: How do I use path parameters? How do I handle wildcard routes?
JSON response handling. Automatic JSON conversion for objects. Return object for JSON serialization. Questions: How do I return JSON? Is JSON serialization automatic?
File responses with formdata. file() function for file attachment. 1-level deep object for file response. Multipart formdata response. Questions: How do I return files? How do I use file() function?

Custom headers and status codes. set.headers for setting response headers. x-powered-by header example. status() function for custom status codes. 418 I'm a teapot status code. Questions: How do I set response headers? How do I set custom status codes?

Route grouping with prefix. .group(prefix, callback) for grouped routes. Subroutes under common prefix. /auth prefix example. Multiple routes in group callback. Questions: How do I group related routes? How do I use route prefixes?

Schema validation for routes. t.Object() for object validation. t.String() for string type. t.Number() for number type. body parameter in handler. body schema option. Validation enforcement per route. Questions: How do I validate request body? What is the t object?

File upload handling. t.File() for single file. t.Files() for multiple files. format option for MIME types. format: 'image/*' for images. multipart/form-data. Questions: How do I handle file uploads? What options are available?

Lifecycle hooks for request handling. onRequest hook at start. on('beforeHandle') before route handler. afterHandle in route options. Hook execution order. Questions: What hooks are available? How do I use hooks? What's the execution order?

Guard for enforcing schema on subroutes. .guard() method with schema. response option for response validation. @errors: 2345 for schema violation. Schema enforcement across grouped routes. Questions: How do I enforce schema on multiple routes? What is a guard?

Custom context with state and decorators. .state(key, value) for global mutable state. .decorate(key, value) for immutable properties. store access pattern. store.version access in handler. Questions: How do I extend context? What's the difference between state and decorate?
Redirect responses. redirect() function in context. Path parameter to redirect to. Questions: How do I redirect? How do I use redirect()?

Plugin system for code reuse. new Elysia() for plugin instance. .use(plugin) for integration. store access in plugin. plugin-version property. Questions: How do I create plugins? How do I use plugins?

WebSocket support for real-time. .ws(path, handlers) method. message event handler. message parameter from client. ws.send() to send to client. Questions: How do I use WebSocket? How do I handle messages?
OpenAPI documentation generation. @elysia/openapi plugin. .use(openapi()). Documentation page at /openapi. Scalar or Swagger UI. Questions: How do I generate API documentation? How do I use OpenAPI?

Unit testing with Elysia. Bun test framework integration. describe() and it() for tests. app.handle() for direct testing. new Request() for test requests. response.text() for response body. Questions: How do I test Elysia? How do I use app.handle()?

Custom body parser. onParse lifecycle hook. request.text() for text parsing. Custom content type handling. application/custom-type example. Questions: How do I parse custom body types? How do I use onParse?

GraphQL integration. GraphQL Yoga plugin @elysia/graphql-yoga. yoga() plugin setup. typeDefs for GraphQL schema. resolvers for query handling. Questions: How do I use GraphQL? How do I set up GraphQL Yoga?
